findings.issue: These items treat heating ethanol as required. Benedict's test is heated in a water bath. The standard ethanol emulsion test mixes ethanol with the sample and then adds water; it does not heat the ethanol. bio-y8-app-food-test-match already states lipid as ethanol then water.
The prompt asks for a strong positive Benedict's result, but accepted answers include 'orange or brick-red' and 'green yellow orange or brick-red'.
64 scenario MCQs cover 16 result combinations, four question IDs each. Correct options match the stated observations, but they are not 64 distinct concepts.
All 9 non-case MCQs contain at least one out-of-topic distractor. Two also contain one nearer distractor: Benedict's solution on the Biuret item, and lilac or purple on the brick-red item.
52 mark_points items have no markPointAlternatives. Marking fairness for equivalent scientific wording is not yet tested, so this is not recorded as a proven mis-mark.
